entries.prompt: US Air Force Lockheed Martin F-35A Lightning II, three-quarter rear view from the left, parked on an airfield apron in daylight, photographic reference. Stealth-shaped body with sharp chines, a single large F135 engine nozzle with serrated edges between the twin canted vertical tails, all-moving horizontal stabilators with sawtooth edges level with the nozzle, trapezoidal wing with straight leading and trailing edges, the frameless one-piece canopy, tricycle landing gear, internal weapons bay doors closed, no external stores, uniform dark grey radar-absorbent coating with low-visibility USAF markings. Whole aircraft in frame, no people, no ground equipment, no text.

entries.prompt: US Marine Corps Lockheed Martin F-35B Lightning II, straight head-on front view at eye level on an airfield apron in daylight, photographic reference. Pointed chined radome, the frameless bubble canopy with the lift-fan door hump behind it, two caret (diverterless bump) intakes either side of the nose with their mouths open and dark (no intake covers), trapezoidal wing level, twin vertical tails canted outward, tricycle landing gear with the nose gear centred, no external stores, uniform dark grey coating. Whole aircraft in frame, symmetric, no people, no covers, no text.
